scripts.prepare-deploy: export JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 && npm install -g aws-cdk@latest && npm install aws-sdk && cdk --version && cd ../webapp && npm install && npm run build && ls -l build/ && cd ../cdk-stacks && npm install && ls -l node_modules && cd lambdas && npm install && ls -l node_modules && cd .. && npm i -g esbuild && npm run build-lambda-edge
scripts.deploy-backend: export JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 && npm run cdk:synth && cdk diff && cdk deploy GenAILabs-Demo-BackendStack --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-backend-outputs.json -c application_version=$npm_package_version && cat cdk-backend-outputs.json
scripts.deploy-frontend: export JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 && cdk deploy GenAILabs-Demo-FrontendStack --require-approval never --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json -c application_version=$npm_package_version && cat cdk-outputs.json && export WEB_APP_URL=$(jq -r '."GenAILabs-Demo-FrontendStack".webAppURL' cdk-outputs.json) && export CLOUDFRONT_DIST_ID=$(jq -r '."GenAILabs-Demo-FrontendStack".cloudfrontDistributionId' cdk-outputs.json) && node update-user-pool.mjs && node generate-frontend-config.mjs && node invalidate-cache.mjs $CLOUDFRONT_DIST_ID
scripts.cdk:deploy: npm run prepare-deploy && npm run deploy-backend && npm run deploy-frontend
